confirmed_policy.word_output: DOCX with editable body, tables, headers, footers, footnotes, endnotes and text boxes; no OCR
confirmed_policy.token_match: Intact uppercase codes only; no guessing or whitespace repair
confirmed_policy.unknown_eligible_codes: Block output and list codes; new document types do not inherit legacy KEEP relaxation
confirmed_policy.markdown_exclusions: Code, link targets and reference identifiers, HTML tags and code regions; report preserved codes
confirmed_policy.json: String values only; keys, types, numeric lexemes and structure preserved
confirmed_policy.clipboard: Explicit paste/copy actions only; separate source and read-only output; no autosave or upload

validated_behaviors: Word split formatting runs and all supported stories restore correctly
Word styles, media, relationships, source document and vault unchanged
Visible Word breaks, tabs, hyphens and note markers never glue tokens
Restored Word newlines and tabs use explicit Word elements
Markdown protected code, URLs, references and HTML preserved and reported
JSON quotes, backslashes, newlines and Unicode escapes remain valid
JSON duplicate keys and nonstandard constants rejected
Unknown code prevents file or clipboard result publication
Input edits invalidate results and stale worker responses are discarded
Clipboard remains unchanged until Copy is explicitly clicked
Mixed CSV, HTML, Markdown, JSON and Word batch exports same-type outputs
Cancellation and source mutation do not publish results
Existing destination and source aliases never overwritten
batch_atomicity: Per file; previously completed outputs remain if a later file fails
